title: security-headers: a command line grader for HTTP security response headers
description:
Zero-dependency Node.js command line tool that inspects a site's HTTP response headers (HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and others), grades the result from A+ to F, and reports what each missing or weak header leaves exposed. Emits table, JSON and SARIF 2.1.0 output and exits non-zero below a configurable grade, so it can gate a CI pipeline.

Documentation: https://trustyourwebsite.github.io/security-headers/. Released on npm as @trustyourwebsite/security-headers under the MIT licence.

Maintained by TrustYourWebsite, which runs this check and others as a hosted scanner for businesses in the EU and the UK, and by Get Up to Code, the same scanner for the United States and Canada. This tool performs technical analysis and does not provide legal advice.
